verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Ataa amru Allaahi falaa tasta'jiloohu subhaanahu wa ta'aalaa ammaa yushrikoon
Yunazzilul-malaa'ikata bir-roohi min amrihi alaa man yashaa'u min ibaadihi an andhiroo annahu laa ilaaha illaa anaa fattaqoon
Khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqqi ta'aalaa ammaa yushrikoon
Khalaqal-insaana min nutfatin fa-idhaa huwa khaseemun mubeen
Wal-an'aama khalaqahaa lakum feehaa dif'un wa manaafi'u wa minhaa ta'kuloon
Wa lakum feehaa jamaalun heena tureehoona wa heena tasrahoon
Wa tahmilu athqaalakum ilaa baladin lam takoonoo baaligheehi illaa bishiqqil-anfusi inna rabbakum lara'oofun Raheem
Wal-khayla wal-bighaala wal-hameera litarkaboohaa wa zeenatan wa yakhluqu maa laa ta'lamoon
Wa alaa Allaahi qasdus-sabeeli wa minhaa jaa'irun wa law shaa'a lahadaakum ajma'een
Huwal-ladhee anzala minas-samaa'i maa'an lakum minhu sharaabun wa minhu shajarun feehi tuseemoon
Yunbitu lakum bihiz-zar'a waz-zaytoona wan-nakheela wal-a'naaba wa min kullith-thamaraati inna fee dhaalika la-aayatan liqawmin yatafakkaroon
Wa sakhkhara lakumul-layla wan-nahaara wash-shamsa wal-qamara wan-nujoomu musakhkharaatun bi-amrihi inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin liqawmin ya'qiloon
Wa maa dhara'a lakum fil-ardi mukhtalifan alwaanuhu inna fee dhaalika la-aayatan liqawmin yadhdhakkaroon
Wa huwal-ladhee sakhkharal-bahra lita'kuloo minhu lahman tariyyan wa tastakhrijoo minhu hilyatan talbasoonahaa wa taral-fulka mawaakhira feehi wa litabtaghoo min fadlihi wa la-allakum tashkuroon
Wa alqaa fil-ardi rawaasiya an tameeda bikum wa anhaaran wa subulan la-allakum tahtadoon
Wa alaamaatin wa bin-najmi hum yahtadoon
Afaman yakhluqu kaman laa yakhluqu afalaa tadhakkaroon
Wa in ta'uddoo ni'matallaahi laa tuhsoohaa innallaaha laghafoorun Raheem
Wallaahu ya'lamu maa tusirroona wa maa tu'linoon
Wal-ladheena yad'oona min doonillaahi laa yakhluqoona shay'an wa hum yukhlaqoon
Amwaatun ghayru ahyaa'in wa maa yash'uroona ayyaana yub'athoon
Ilaahukum ilaahun waahidun fa-al-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati quloobuhum munkiratun wa hum mustakbiroon
Laa jarama annallaaha ya'lamu maa yusirroona wa maa yu'linoona innahu laa yuhibbul-mustakbireen
Wa idhaa qeela lahum maadhaa anzala rabbukum qaaloo asaateerul-awwaleen
Liyahmiloo awzaarahum kaamilatan yawmal-qiyaamati wa min awzaaril-ladheena yudilloonahum bighayri ilmin alaa saa'a maa yaziroon
Qad makaral-ladheena min qablihim fa-ataa Allaahu bunyaanahum minal-qawaa'idi fakharra alayhimus-saqfu min fawqihim wa ataahumul-adhaabu min haythu laa yash'uroon
Thumma yawmal-qiyaamati yukhzeehim wa yaqoolu ayna shurakaa'iyal-ladheena kuntum tushaaqqoona feehim qaalal-ladheena ootul-ilma innal-khizyal-yawma was-soo'a alal-kaafireen
Al-ladheena tatawaffaahumul-malaa'ikatu zaalimee anfusihim fa-alqaw as-salama maa kunnaa na'malu min soo'in balaa innallaaha aleemun bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
Fadkhuloo abwaaba jahannama khaalideena feehaa falabi'sa mathwal-mutakabbireen
Wa qeela lilladheena ittaqaw maadhaa anzala rabbukum qaaloo khayran lilladheena ahsanoo fee haadhihid-dunyaa hasanatun wa ladaarul-aakhirati khayrun wa lani'ma daarul-muttaqeen
Jannaatu adnin yadkhuloonahaa tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru lahum feehaa maa yashaa'oona kadhaalika yajzee Allaahul-muttaqeen
Al-ladheena tatawaffaahumul-malaa'ikatu tayyibeena yaqooloona salaamun alaykumu udkhulul-jannata bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
Hal yanzuroona illaa an ta'tiyahumul-malaa'ikatu aw ya'tiya amru rabbika kadhaalika fa-alal-ladheena min qablihim wa maa zalamahumu Allaahu wa laakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
Fa-asaabahum sayyi'aatu maa amiloo wa haaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihi yastahzi'oon

Wa qaalal-ladheena ashrakoo law shaa'a Allaahu maa abadnaa min doonihi min shay'in nahnu wa laa aabaa'uunaa wa laa harramnaa min doonihi min shay'in kadhaalika fa-alal-ladheena min qablihim fahal alar-rusuli illal-balaaghul-mubeen

Wa laqad ba'athnaa fee kulli ummatin rasoolan ani-u'budoo Allaaha wajtanibut-taaghoota faminhum man hadaa Allaahu wa minhum man haqqat alayhid-dalaalatu faseeroo fil-ardi fanzuroo kayfa kaana aaqibatul-mukadhdhibeen
In tahris alaa hudaahum fa-innallaaha laa yahdee man yudillu wa maa lahum min naasireen
Wa aqsamoo Billaahi jahda aymaanihim laa yab'athu Allaahu man yamootu balaa wa'dan alayhi haqqan wa laakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Liyubayyina lahumul-ladhee yakhtalifoona feehi wa liya'lamal-ladheena kafaroo annahum kaanoo kaadhibeen
Innamaa qawlunaa lishay'in idhaa aradnaahu an naqoola lahu kun fayakoon
Wal-ladheena haajaroo fee Allaahi min ba'di maa zulimoo lanubawwi'annahum fid-dunyaa hasanatan wa la-ajrul-aakhirati akbaru law kaanoo ya'lamoon
Al-ladheena sabaroo wa alaa rabbihim yatawakkaloon
Wa maa arsalnaa min qablika illaa rijaalan noohee ilayhim faas'aloo ahladh-dhikri in kuntum laa ta'lamoon
Bil-bayyinaati waz-zuburi wa anzalnaa ilaykadh-dhikra litubayyina lin-naasi maa nuzzila ilayhim wa la-allahum yatafakkaroon
Afa'aminal-ladheena makarus-sayyi'aati an yakhsifa Allaahu bihimul-arda aw ya'tiyahumul-adhaabu min haythu laa yash'uroon
Aw ya'khudhahum fee taqallubihim famaa hum bimu'jizeen
Aw ya'khudhahum alaa takhawwufin fa-inna rabbakum lara'oofun Raheem
Awalam yaraw ilaa maa khalaqa Allaahu min shay'in yatafayya'u zilaaluhu anil-yameeni wash-shamaa'ili sujjadan Lillaahi wa hum daakhiroon
Wa Lillaahi yasjudu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi min daabbatin wal-malaa'ikatu wa hum laa yastakbiroon
Yakhaafoona rabbahum min fawqihim wa yaf'aloona maa yu'maroon
Wa qaala Allaahu laa tattakhidhoo ilahayni ithnayni innamaa huwa ilaahun waahidun fa-iyyaaya farhaboon
Wa lahu maa fis-samaawaati wal-ardi wa lahud-deenu wasiban afaghayra Allaahi tattaqoon
Wa maa bikum min ni'matin famina Allaahi thumma idhaa massakumud-durru fa-ilayhi taj'aroon
Thumma idhaa kashafad-durra ankum idhaa fareequn minkum birabbihim yushrikoon
Liyakfuroo bimaa aataynaahum fatamatta'oo fasawfa ta'lamoon
Wa yaj'aloona limaa laa ya'lamoona naseeban mimmaa razaqnaahum ta-Allaahi latus'alunna ammaa kuntum taftaroon
Wa yaj'aloona Lillaahil-banaati subhaanahu wa lahum maa yashtahoon
Wa idhaa bushshira ahaduhum bil-unthaa zalla wajhuhu muswaddan wa huwa kazeem
Yatawaaraa minal-qawmi min soo'i maa bushshira bihi ayumsikuhu alaa hoonin am yadussuhu fit-turaabi alaa saa'a maa yahkumoon
Lilladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati mathalus-saw'i wa Lillaahil-mathalul-a'laa wa huwal-azeezul-hakeem
Wa law yu'uaakhidhu Allaahun-naasa bizulmihim maa taraka alayhaa min daabbatin wa laakin yu'uakhkhiruhum ilaa ajalin musamman fa-idhaa jaa'a ajaluhum laa yasta'khiroona saa'atan wa laa yastaqdimoon
Wa yaj'aloona Lillaahi maa yakrahoona wa tasifu alsinatuhumul-kadhiba anna lahumul-husnaa laa jarama anna lahumun-naara wa annahum mufratoon
Ta-Allaahi laqad arsalnaa ilaa umamin min qablika fazayyana lahumush-shaytaanu a'maalahum fahuwa waliyyuhumul-yawma wa lahum adhaabun aleem
Wa maa anzalnaa alaykal-kitaaba illaa litubayyina lahumul-ladhee ikhtalafoo feehi wa hudan wa rahmatan liqawmin yu'minoon
Wallaahu anzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fa-ahyaa bihil-arda ba'da mawtihaa inna fee dhaalika la-aayatan liqawmin yasma'oon
Wa inna lakum fil-an'aam la-ibratan nusqeekum mimmaa fee butoonihi min bayni farthin wa damin labanan khaalisan saa'ighan lish-shaaribeen
Wa min thamaraatin-nakheeli wal-a'naabi tattakhidhoona minhu sakaran wa rizqan hasanan inna fee dhaalika la-aayatan liqawmin ya'qiloon
Wa awhaa rabbuka ilan-nahli anit-takhidhee minal-jibaali buyootan wa minash-shajari wa mimmaa ya'rishoon

Thumma kulee min kullith-thamaraati faslukee subula rabbiki dhululan yakhruju min butoonihaa sharaabun mukhtalifun alwaanuhu feehi shifaa'un lin-naasi inna fee dhaalika la-aayatan liqawmin yatafakkaroon
Wallaahu khalaqakum thumma yatawaffaakum wa minkum man yuraddu ilaa ardhalil-umuri likay laa ya'lama ba'da ilmin shay'an innallaaha aleemun qadeer
Wallaahu faddala ba'dakum alaa ba'din fir-rizqi famal-ladheena fuddiloo biraaddee rizqihim alaa maa malakat aymaanuhum fahum feehi sawaa'un afabini'mati Allaahi yajhadoon
Wallaahu ja'ala lakum min anfusikum azwaajan wa ja'ala lakum min azwaajikum baneena wa hafadatan wa razaqakum minat-tayyibaati afabiaalbaatili yu'minoona wa bini'mati Allaahi hum yakfuroon
Wa ya'budoona min doonillaahi maa laa yamliku lahum rizqan minas-samaawaati wal-ardi shay'an wa laa yastatee'oon
Falaa tadriboo Lillaahil-amthaala innallaaha ya'lamu wa antum laa ta'lamoon

Daraba Allaahu mathalan abdan mamlookan laa yaqdiru alaa shay'in wa man razaqnaahu minnaa rizqan hasanan fahuwa yunfiqu minhu sirran wa jahran hal yastawoonal-hamdu Lillaahi bal aktharuhum laa ya'lamoon

Wa daraba Allaahu mathalan rajulayni ahaduhumaa abkamu laa yaqdiru alaa shay'in wa huwa kallun alaa mawlaahu aynamaa yuwajjhhhu laa ya'ti bikhayrin hal yastawee huwa wa man ya'muru bil-adli wa huwa alaa siraatin mustaqeem
Wa Lillaahi ghaybus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa maa amrus-saa'ati illaa kalamhil-basari aw huwa aqrabu innallaaha alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Wallaahu akhrajakum min butooni ummahaatikum laa ta'lamoona shay'an wa ja'ala lakumus-sam'a wal-absaara wal-af'idata la-allakum tashkuroon
Alam yaraw ilat-tayri musakhkharaatin fee jawwis-samaa'i maa yumsikuhunna illaa Allaahu inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin liqawmin yu'minoon

Wallaahu ja'ala lakum min buyootikum sakanan wa ja'ala lakum min juloodil-an'aami buyootan tastakhiffoonahaa yawma za'nikum wa yawma iqaamatikum wa min aswaafihaa wa awbaarihaa wa ash'aarihaa athaathan wa mataa'an ilaa heen

Wallaahu ja'ala lakum mimmaa khalaqa zilaalan wa ja'ala lakum minal-jibaali aknaanan wa ja'ala lakum saraabeela taqeekumul-harra wa saraabeela taqeekum ba'sakum kadhaalika yutimmu ni'matahu alaykum la-allakum tuslimoon
Fa-in tawallaw fa-innamaa alaykal-balaaghul-mubeen
Ya'rifoona ni'matallaahi thumma yunkiroonahaa wa aktharuhumul-kaafiroon
Wa yawma nab'athu min kulli ummatin shaheedan thumma laa yu'udhanu lilladheena kafaroo wa laa hum yusta'taboon
Wa idhaa ra'al-ladheena zalamul-adhaaba falaa yukhaffafu anhum wa laa hum yunzaroon
Wa idhaa ra'al-ladheena ashrakoo shurakaa'ahum qaaloo rabbanaa haa'ulaa'i shurakaa'uunal-ladheena kunnaa nad'oo min doonika fa-alqaw ilayhimul-qawla innakum lakaadhiboon
Wa alqaw ilaa Allaahi yawma'idhin as-salama wa dalla anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon
Al-ladheena kafaroo wa saddoo an sabeelillaahi zidnaahum adhaaban fawqal-adhaabi bimaa kaanoo yufsidoon

Wa yawma nab'athu fee kulli ummatin shaheedan alayhim min anfusihim wa ji'naa bika shaheedan alaa haa'ulaa'i wa nazzalnaa alaykal-kitaaba tibyaanan likulli shay'in wa hudan wa rahmatan wa bushraa lilmuslimeen
Innallaaha ya'muru bil-adli wal-ihsaani wa eetaa'i dhil-qurbaa wa yanhaa anil-fahshaa'i wal-munkari wal-baghyi ya'izukum la-allakum tadhakkaroon
Wa awfoo bi-ahdi Allaahi idhaa aahadtum wa laa tanqudul-aymaana ba'da tawkeedihaa wa qad ja'altumu Allaaha alaykum kafeelan innallaaha ya'lamu maa taf'aloon

Wa laa takoonoo kal-latee naqadat ghazlahaa min ba'di quwwatin ankaathan tattakhidhoona aymaanakum dakhalan baynakum an takoona ummatun hiya arbaa min ummatin innamaa yablookumu Allaahu bihi wa layubayyinanna lakum yawmal-qiyaamati maa kuntum feehi takhtalifoon
Wa law shaa'a Allaahu laja'alakum ummatan waahidatan wa laakin yudillu man yashaa'u wa yahdee man yashaa'u wa latus'alunna ammaa kuntum ta'maloon
Wa laa tattakhidhoo aymaanakum dakhalan baynakum fatazilla qadamun ba'da thubootihaa wa tadhooqus-soo'a bimaa sadadtum an sabeelillaahi wa lakum adhaabun azeem
Wa laa tashtaroo bi-ahdi Allaahi thamanan qaleelan innamaa indallaahi huwa khayrun lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon
Maa indakum yanfadu wa maa indallaahi baaqin wa lanajziyannal-ladheena sabaroo ajrahum bi-ahsani maa kaanoo ya'maloon
Man amila saalihan min dhakarin aw unthaa wa huwa mu'minun falanuhyiyannahu hayaatan tayyibatan wa lanajziyannahum ajrahum bi-ahsani maa kaanoo ya'maloon
Fa-idhaa qara'tal-qur'aana fasta'idh Billaahi minash-shaytaanir-rajeem
Innahu laysa lahu sultaanun alal-ladheena aamanoo wa alaa rabbihim yatawakkaloon
Innamaa sultaanuhu alal-ladheena yatawallawnahu wal-ladheena hum bihi mushrikoon
Wa idhaa baddalnaa aayatan makaana aayatin Wallaahu a'lamu bimaa yunazzilu qaaloo innamaa anta muftarin bal aktharuhum laa ya'lamoon
Qul nazzalahu roohul-qudusi min rabbika bil-haqqi liyuthabbital-ladheena aamanoo wa hudan wa bushraa lilmuslimeen
Wa laqad na'lamu annahum yaqooloona innamaa yu'allimuhu basharun lisaanul-ladhee yulhidoona ilayhi a'jamiyyun wa haadhaa lisaanun arabiyyun mubeen
Innal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bi-aayaati Allaahi laa yahdeehimu Allaahu wa lahum adhaabun aleem
Innamaa yaftaril-kadhibal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bi-aayaati Allaahi wa ulaa'ika humul-kaadhiboon
Man kafara Billaahi min ba'di eemaanihi illaa man ukriha wa qalbuhu mutma'innun bil-eemaani wa laakin man sharaha bil-kufri sadran fa-alayhim ghadabun mina Allaahi wa lahum adhaabun azeem
Dhaalika bi-annahumu istahabbul-hayaatad-dunyaa alal-aakhirati wa annallaaha laa yahdil-qawmal-kaafireen
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena taba'a Allaahu alaa quloobihim wa sam'ihim wa absaarihim wa ulaa'ika humul-ghaafiloon
Laa jarama annahum fil-aakhirati humul-khaasiroon
Thumma inna rabbaka lilladheena haajaroo min ba'di maa futinoo thumma jaahadoo wa sabaroo inna rabbaka min ba'dihaa laghafoorun Raheem
Yawma ta'tee kullu nafsin tujaadilu an nafsihaa wa tuwaffaa kullu nafsin maa amilat wa hum laa yuzlamoon

Wa daraba Allaahu mathalan qaryatan kaanat aaminatan mutma'innatan ya'teehaa rizquhaa raghadan min kulli makaanin fakafarat bi-an'umi Allaahi fa-adhaaqahaa Allaahu libaasal-joo'i wal-khawfi bimaa kaanoo yasna'oon
Wa laqad jaa'ahum rasoolun minhum fakadhdhaboohu fa-akhadhahumul-adhaabu wa hum zaalimoon
Fakuloo mimmaa razaqakumu Allaahu halaalan tayyiban washkuroo ni'matallaahi in kuntum iyyaahu ta'budoon
Innamaa harrama alaykumul-maytata wad-dama wa lahmal-khinzeeri wa maa uhilla lighayri Allaahi bihi famani udturra ghayra baaghin wa laa aadin fa-innallaaha ghafoorun Raheem
Wa laa taqooloo limaa tasifu alsinatukumul-kadhiba haadhaa halaalun wa haadhaa haraamun litaftaroo alaa Allaahil-kadhiba innal-ladheena yaftaroona alaa Allaahil-kadhiba laa yuflihoon
Mataa'un qaleelun wa lahum adhaabun aleem
Wa alal-ladheena haadoo harramnaa maa qasasnaa alayka min qablu wa maa zalamnaahum wa laakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
Thumma inna rabbaka lilladheena amilus-soo'a bijahaalatin thumma taaboo min ba'di dhaalika wa aslahoo inna rabbaka min ba'dihaa laghafoorun Raheem
Inna ibraaheema kaana ummatan qaanitan Lillaahi haneefan wa lam yaku minal-mushrikeen
Shaakiran li'n'umihi ijtabaahu wa hadaahu ilaa siraatin mustaqeem
Wa aataynaahu fid-dunyaa hasanatan wa innahu fil-aakhirati laminas-saaliheen
Thumma awhaynaa ilayka anit-tabi millata ibraaheema haneefan wa maa kaana minal-mushrikeen
Innamaa ju'ilas-sabtu alal-ladheena ikhtalafoo feehi wa inna rabbaka layahkumu baynahum yawmal-qiyaamati feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
Ud'u ilaa sabeeli rabbika bil-hikmati wal-maw'izatil-hasanati wa jaadilhum billatee hiya ahsanu inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu biman dalla an sabeelihi wa huwa a'lamu bil-muhtadeen
Wa in aaqabtum fa-aaqiboo bimithli maa ooqibtum bihi wa la-in sabartum lahuwa khayrun lis-saabireen
Wasbir wa maa sabruka illaa Billaahi wa laa tahzan alayhim wa laa taku fee dayqin mimmaa yamkuroon
Innallaaha ma'al-ladheena ittaqaw wal-ladheena hum muhsinoon
